text:
alex: Quick sync — we need a governance checklist for Snowflake + Databricks + vector DB listings before we coordinate a joint announcement. Also need a legal signoff window. Can we align on dependencies and a target date?

maria: +1. Proposed checklist items: listing content + screenshots, pricing/sku mapping, telemetry/telemetry opt-out language, SLA matrix, data handling & DPA, sample onboarding flow. I can draft. :white_check_mark:

cheng: From infra: confirm packaging differences for Snowbridge vs DBX connector. Also need to validate quantization/FP perf numbers for the vector path. One blocker: sidecar adapter currently lacks automated API-key rotation — will need that for Snowflake partner security requirements.

samir: Don't forget marketplace entitlements and embargo windows. If we want an external announcement mid-April, we need partner + legal acceptance by 2027-04-01. Realistic?

emily_legal: Emily (legal) here — I'll request the DPA + data handling addendum from Snowflake & Databricks today. If partners are responsive, we can do an expedited review but need a firm spec for telemetry and retention. Expect initial review ETA: 5 business days.

alex: Thanks. Maria, can you coordinate partner ETA? @partners-bot do we have an internal listing template for co-signed marketplace entries?

partners-bot: Marketplace templates are here: https://internal.redwood/docs/marketplace-templates. Listing checklist (v2) PDF: /drive/marketplace_checklist_v2.pdf. Note: include section for "partner entitlements" and "region residency".

maria: Looping in partner PMs at Snowflake and Databricks now. I'll ask for DPA + confirmation on embargo windows. Draft checklist by EOD and share for comments.

cheng: Tech detail for vector DBs — ensure embeddings schema mapping is explicit and sample code for conversion is included in the docs. Example mapping we want in the listing docs:

```json
{
  "embedding_field": "redwood_embedding_v1",
  "dimension": 1536,
  "namespace": "docs",
  "metadata": {"source": "connector", "created_by": "redwood"}
}
```

cheng: Also add a note: "client-side key rotation + server-side least-priv privilege role" required for Snowbridge connector.

samir: Timing question — partners want a single co-announcement or staggered marketplace listing then press? My preference: staged listing (marketplace first) then blog/press after 7 days to catch onboarding metrics.

emily_legal: Staged is safer re: legal signoffs; gives us time to patch any disclosure items. If we're doing staged, we still need a formal rollback plan in case a partner blocks.

alex: Action items from thread:
- maria: draft checklist + ping partners (by EOD)
- emily_legal: request DPAs and share legal gating doc (today)
- cheng: scope API-key rotation work and estimate (EOW)
- samir: propose announcement cadence and draft internal comms (tomorrow)

maria: Created PR with checklist draft: https://git.internal/redwood/marketplace-listings/pulls/482. Assigned reviewers: @emily_legal, @cheng, @samir. I'll run a sync Tue 10am PT to finalize timeline.

alex: Perfect — thanks everyone. If partners confirm DPA quickly we can keep the 4/15 external announcement target, otherwise we default to staged listing + 1-week press. :rocket:

maria: Noted. I'll post updates in this thread and ping the partner PMs when the checklist is ready.
